hotel.name: Novotel Danang Premier Han River
hotel.address: 36 Bach Dang, Hai Chau, Da Nang (Han River west bank — city/river, NOT beach)

tip: Only ~1.5–2 activity days: Ba Na full day Sat 26 + Dragon Bridge Fri/Sat (both fire-show nights). Asia Park & Helio market CLOSED/suspended — skip. Mikazuki OR Son Tra as flex half-day.

booking.how: Klook / Sun World / private car; buy for Sat 26

priceFamilyEst.note: estimate: adult 1M / child 1–1.4m 800k; family ~4.5–6.5M tickets + food — ≥1.4m = adult; verify heights

attractions.name: Ba Na Hills + Golden Bridge + Fantasy Park
attractions.shortDescription: Cable car, Golden Bridge hands, French Village, and indoor Fantasy Park — the #1 Da Nang ticket day.
attractions.whyKids: 8/9 love Fantasy Park; 12yo Alpine Coaster; fog common Sep–Feb but indoors saves the day.
attractions.reviewSummary: Hebrew + English family consensus ‘whole day.’ Weekend queues on Sat 26 — go early / WOW Pass if offered.
attractions.duration: Full day — do NOT combine with Mikazuki
attractions.mapsQuery: Ba Na Hills Golden Bridge, Da Nang

combos: east-bank Son Tra night market snacks
attractions.name: Dragon Bridge fire & water show
attractions.shortDescription: Free dragon that breathes real fire ~21:00 Fri–Sun — your Fri 25 + Sat 26 are both show nights.
attractions.whyKids: All ages love it; loud blast — stand back if sensitive. Arrive ~20:30.
attractions.reviewSummary: KissTour + dananghotelguide staple; light rain usually OK, heavy storm may cancel.
attractions.distanceFromHotel: 10–20 min walk along Bach Dang / bridges

combos: Xuan Thieu bay beach in front if ocean red-flagged

booking.how: gate / official / OTA; bring swimsuits + lockers

priceFamilyEst.note: estimate weekend adult ~375–460k / child 1–1.4m ~170–270k — sources disagree; verify live

attractions.name: Mikazuki Water Park 365 (+ Onsen)
attractions.shortDescription: Indoor heated dome — wave pool, slides, lazy river — best December rain insurance.
attractions.whyKids: 8–12 ideal; tall kids may hit adult slide minimums (~1.39m) — check on site. Onsen rules for under-12.
attractions.reviewSummary: thingstododanang + hoiandaytrip; wrong direction from Ba Na — separate day only.

priceFamilyEst.note: free entry; parking ~5–20k; Grab one-way often ~80–150k cited — verify app

attractions.name: Sơn Trà Peninsula + Linh Ứng (Lady Buddha)
attractions.shortDescription: 67m Lady Buddha, bay views, monkeys (do not feed) — free scenic half-morning.
attractions.whyKids: Iconic photo + scenic drive; modest dress; early morning best.
attractions.reviewSummary: Free culture/nature; flexible Fri late morning or Sun early IF flight allows.
attractions.mapsQuery: Linh Ung Pagoda Lady Buddha Da Nang

attractions.name: My Khe Beach promenade / An Thuong
attractions.shortDescription: Classic Da Nang beach strip — Dec swim often rough/red-flag; still great for walk, coconut, sand play.
attractions.whyKids: All ages for promenade; check lifeguard flags before swim.
attractions.reviewSummary: KissTour kids beach day; city-base hotel means 10–20 min Grab.

priceFamilyEst.note: estimate: entry 40k + elevator 15k each way + Am Phu 20k; under 10 often free main — verify

attractions.name: Marble Mountains (Thủy Sơn)
attractions.shortDescription: Caves, pagodas, viewpoints — elevator optional for tired legs; easy Fri 25 transfer stop.
attractions.whyKids: 8–12 handle stairs with elevator backup; skip if already ‘templed out’ after Mỹ Sơn.
attractions.reviewSummary: Cheap corridor stop Hoi An→Da Nang; don’t stack with Ba Na same day.
attractions.distanceFromHotel: 20–30 min south / on Hoi An corridor

combos: Da Nang Museum on Bach Dang

priceFamilyEst.note: estimate from 01/01/2026: adult 60k — kids policy verify at door

attractions.name: Museum of Cham Sculpture
attractions.shortDescription: World’s largest Cham sculpture collection — air-con midday / rainy gold; pairs with Mỹ Sơn story.
attractions.reviewSummary: Central rainy stack; confirm hours (some sources say closed Mon).
attractions.mapsQuery: Museum of Cham Sculpture Da Nang

attractions.name: Bach Dang Walking Street + Han River promenade
attractions.shortDescription: Evening stroll, Christmas lights, cafés — decompress outside the Novotel door.
attractions.whyKids: Safe energy burn on promenade before Dragon Bridge.
attractions.reviewSummary: City/river base advantage for short 2n stay.
attractions.mapsQuery: Bach Dang Walking Street Da Nang

attractions.name: Love Bridge (Cầu Tình Yêu)
attractions.shortDescription: Short heart-locks photo stop — NOT the Golden Bridge (that’s at Ba Na).
attractions.whyKids: Fun myth-bust for kids who confuse ‘Golden Bridge in the city’.
attractions.distanceFromHotel: Short walk from riverfront / Dragon Bridge area

combos: Con Market food hall another meal
attractions.name: Han Market (Chợ Hàn)
attractions.shortDescription: Easy souvenirs + dried fruit — short rainy stop; FB Novotel city-base reports mention it.
attractions.reviewSummary: Open; better souvenirs than food (Con Market wins food).

priceFamilyEst.note: estimate meals often ~40–100k+/dish — pay stall prices

attractions.name: Con Market (Chợ Con) food hall
attractions.shortDescription: Local cooked-hot food stalls — best ‘real food’ market vs Han.
attractions.whyKids: Family-friendly if you pick hot dishes; cash.
attractions.reviewSummary: KissTour + markets guides; still open per closed-attractions register.

priceFamilyEst.note: estimate snacks 15–50k; seafood skewers higher — cash

attractions.name: Son Tra / Dragon Bridge Night Market
attractions.shortDescription: East-bank grilled seafood, coconuts, souvenirs — pairs with fire show 19:30–20:45.
attractions.whyKids: Stools + skewers before the dragon; small bills.
attractions.reviewSummary: dananghotelguide market section staple for show nights.
attractions.distanceFromHotel: Walk bridge or Grab across river
attractions.mapsQuery: Son Tra Night Market Da Nang

combos: spa for adults while kids pool
attractions.name: Novotel pool / apartment downtime
attractions.shortDescription: Two-bedroom apartment river views — Christmas arrival + Sat Ba Na need pool reset.
attractions.whyKids: Recovery between big days and Sunday flight.
attractions.reviewSummary: City/river base praised for short stays; confirm kids pool rules.

attractions.name: Da Nang Cathedral (Pink Church)
attractions.shortDescription: Quick photo / Christmas vibe on Christmas Day — free outside mass.
attractions.reviewSummary: Central free culture filler on Fri 25.

priceFamilyEst.note: check live OTA — do not invent; products vary widely

attractions.name: Han River night cruise (optional)
attractions.shortDescription: Different angle on fire show / lights from the water — short family boat if not exhausted.
attractions.whyKids: Novelty view; skip if walking bridge is enough.
attractions.reviewSummary: Products vary widely on Klook/GYG — verify Christmas weekend availability.

attractions.closedNotes: Helio Center + night market suspended since 5 Sep 2025 — do not plan evening food there.

priceFamilyEst.note: play areas & tickets check live boards — prices change

attractions.name: Vincom / malls + cinema rainy reset
attractions.shortDescription: Playground + CGV/Metiz movie — classic rainy family filler (Helio complex suspended — cinema only maybe).
attractions.whyKids: Pure energy burn if parks cancelled by weather.
attractions.reviewSummary: Indoor roundups; verify venues post-Helio suspension Sep 2025.
